sloka: निष्प्रधानामनेकाग्रां नरेन्द्रेण विना कृताम् ।निवृत्तवनवासोपि नायोध्यां गन्तुमुत्सहे ॥ २.१०२.११॥
transliteration: niṣpradhānāmanekāgrāṁ narendreṇa vinā kṛtām ।nivṛttavanavāsopi nāyodhyāṁ gantumutsahe ॥ 2.102.11॥

translations.english: Even after the completion of my exile I do not wish to return to Ayodhya which is directionless, bereft of its chief, the king.
